rule: Availability is runtime-dependent. Never claim a tool or agent ran unless the resulting state is verified.

surfaces.name: Codex
surfaces.delegate_when: implementation-heavy work requires a coding execution surface

surfaces.name: Claude / Anthropic
surfaces.delegate_when: review/debug adds value, including repeated CI/test failure, security-sensitive diffs, large or ambiguous changes, runtime/adapter errors, or low-confidence implementation results

surfaces.name: Gmail
surfaces.approval: first outbound to a new sales lead or actual external send

surfaces.name: Infisical
surfaces.approval: human_only_for_credential_mutation; read-only metadata may run automatically
